Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        ws.PageSetup.PrintNotes = True
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\on.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        ws.PageSetup.PrintNotes = True
        ws.PageSetup.PrintNotes = False
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\off.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        ws.PageSetup.PrintComments = xlPrintSheetEnd
    Case 4
        ws.PageSetup.PrintComments = xlPrintInPlace
    Case 5
        ws.PageSetup.PrintComments = xlPrintInPlace
        ws.PageSetup.PrintNotes = False
    Case 6
        ws.PageSetup.PrintComments = xlPrintInPlace
        ws.PageSetup.PrintNotes = True
    Case 7
        ws.PageSetup.PrintNotes = 7
    Case 8
        ws.PageSetup.PrintNotes = "True"
    Case 9
        ws.PageSetup.PrintNotes = "x"
    Case 10
        ws.PageSetup.PrintComments = xlPrintSheetEnd
        ws.PageSetup.PrintComments = xlPrintNoComments
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\no_comments.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 11
        ws.PageSetup.PrintErrors = xlPrintErrorsDash
        ws.PageSetup.PrintErrors = xlPrintErrorsDisplayed
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\errors.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 12
        ws.PageSetup.Order = xlOverThenDown
        ws.PageSetup.Order = xlDownThenOver
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\order.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 13
        ws.PageSetup.PrintComments = xlPrintNoComments
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\never_set.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
    Tried = ws.PageSetup.PrintNotes & " " & ws.PageSetup.PrintComments
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 13
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
